toolchain: GNU Binutils 2.45.1 (avr-as/avr-ld/avr-objcopy), Avr8Sharp.TestKit 1.1.0-beta1 (cycle-accurate classic-core AVR sim)
measured_with: hand-written GAS snippets (same method as RFC 0006 section 7 -- these are the mechanism cost, not the compiler's actual output). Bytes = nm label deltas read..read_end (callee) and m_start..m_end (caller); cycles = Cpu.Cycles between the same two byte addresses on ArduinoUnoSimulation. Snippets and the sim harness live on branch rescue/optional-proto under proto/optional-tag/; they are never merged into the RFC branch.
measured_unit: def read() -> Optional[uint8]: if <PINB0>: return None; return 42  /  r = read(); if r is None: led_on(); else: PORTB = r.  The runtime fact is PINB.0 (SBIC/SBIS), which the sim reads as 0; two assembled variants walk each arm. Semantic check: the _val arm leaves PORTB=0x2A (payload 42), the _none arm leaves DDRB=PORTB=0x20 (led).

base.shape: today: plain -> uint8, no None anywhere (the zero-cost gate anchor)
base.note: CALL + OUT only; no check exists because the type cannot be None

a_tflag.shape: T flag carries the tag (SET=none, CLT=value at each return); caller materializes with MOV R19,R1 + BLD R19,0 then TST/BRNE
a_tflag.conflicts: unusable when the callee is CanFail (T already means 'exception in flight', R22 the code) and inside a try body (every call gets a BranchOnError/BRTS inserted before CanFail is known, so a None return reads as an exception). adafruit_dht.measure() raises RuntimeError, so the headline demandant cannot use this wire.

a_tflag_imm.shape: same wire, but the caller consumes T with a bare BRTS -- valid only when `is None` is the very next use before any clobbering call
a_tflag_imm.note: the cheapest read of a tag, but gated on adjacency AND non-CanFail; see RFC open questions

b_tagbyte.shape: tag byte in the return run: R24 payload, R25 tag (8-bit payload; the pair's second register is free). Callee: CLR R25 (value) / LDI R25,1 (none). Caller: MOV tag into the local's tag byte, TST/BRNE.
b_tagbyte.note: uniform: works for CanFail callees and inside try, because the exception channel (T + R22) is untouched

b_tagbyte16.shape: 16-bit payload R24:R25, tag in R22 (arg1's slot, dead at return)

c_sentinel.shape: no tag at all: None is a provably-unused payload value (0xFF for a uint8 the compiler has range-proven). Caller: CPI R24,0xFF + BREQ.
c_sentinel.note: cheapest read, zero materialization -- but only when a payload value is provably free; CPython semantics forbid it otherwise (0xFF is a real uint8). Optimization note, not a representation.

d_outparam.shape: caller passes a pointer to a {payload,tag} slot; callee stores both (MOVW Z + ST/STD). Caller loads tag, tests, loads payload.
d_outparam.sram: +1 byte per stored value (the tag) in the slot; register forms keep the tag in a register until the allocator spills it
d_outparam.note: the heaviest wire, but it is also what a tag FIELD costs (f_field) -- the store form is unavoidable wherever the value must persist

e_union_ifn.shape: Union[int, float, None]: tag in R20, 3 states (snippet: 0=float in R22:R25, 1=int in R24:R25, 2=None; each member returns in its own natural registers, the tag says which are live; declaration order would give int=0). Caller: MOV tag, CPI 2/BREQ (is None), CPI 0/BREQ (isinstance dispatch).
e_union_ifn.note: the value arm's 4xLDI dominates; the tag machinery over (b) is one extra CPI+BREQ per additional member

f_field.shape: Optional field in a Model B slot: slot = {payload byte, tag byte}; store = ST payload + STD tag; `if self._x is None` = LDD tag + TST + BRNE
f_field.note: measured inside main (no call); the adafruit_dht shape is f_field composed with b_tagbyte: field stores the tag, the property returns field.payload + field.tag

summary_deltas_vs_base.comment: whole-unit delta; the two arms' bodies (OUT vs SBI+SBI) are the program's own semantics and constant across candidates
summary_deltas_vs_base.c_sentinel: +10 code bytes, +4/+6 cycles (only when a value is provably free)

diagnostics_today.real_subroutine_optional_return_none: NO DIAGNOSTIC. `def read(pin: uint8) -> Optional[uint8]: if p.value(): return None; return pin + 1` builds; the .mir carries {"$t":"ret","value":{"$t":"none"}}, CompileReturn skips the load and RET runs with R24 = the pin read; the caller's `if r is None:` folds to False (r is not None-known) and its body is dropped. Silent miscompile on both sides.
diagnostics_today.inline_optional_return_none: CompileError at the return: 'PyMCU reads Optional[X] as X, and this return gives None at run time, which has no width to put in the result of 'read'. Return a value on this path, or let the caller decide before calling (the compiler folds `is None` on an argument it can see).'
diagnostics_today.union_int_float_none_return: CompileError at the def: 'a union type annotation is not supported. PyMCU needs one concrete type, because the storage for a value is decided at compile time and two types do not share a size'
diagnostics_today.optional_field_runtime_write: NO DIAGNOSTIC. `self._last: Optional[uint8] = None` then a runtime `self._last = v`/`= None`: both stores emit nothing (the field never gets storage) and `s._last is None` folds on whichever write the compiler saw last.
diagnostics_today.plain_int_return_none_real_subroutine: NO DIAGNOSTIC. `-> int` + runtime `return None` returns the register's residual value (here, 1).
diagnostics_today.optional_param_default_none: works today at zero cost: `x: Optional[uint8] = None` binds a compile-time None, `x is None` folds per call site (the 2026-09-14 decision)
